scenarios.title: Open, edit, and save one locale file
steps: Open BE/ui.txt from the Project tree.
Edit one translation value in the table or detail editor.
Use General -> Save and confirm write action.
Re-open the same file and verify the edited value persists.
expected_checks: No startup errors are shown.
Edited row is marked dirty before save and clean after save.
Saved value remains after re-open.

scenarios.title: Conflict detection and resolution prompt flow
steps: Open BE/ui.txt and apply edits to create draft/cache state.
Trigger conflict handling path from save/open workflow.
Choose merge or keep-disk path in conflict dialog.
Verify table content and status reflect selected resolution.
expected_checks: Conflict dialog appears with deterministic choices.
Selected conflict action is applied consistently.
No crash occurs and file remains operable after resolution.

scenarios.title: Manual QA run and checklist update flow
steps: Open one BE file from perf fixtures.
Switch to QA side panel and trigger Run QA.
Observe checklist state transitions in fixed order.
Navigate at least one finding via list action.
expected_checks: QA panel message indicates manual mode before run.
Checklist rows move through Queued/Running/Completed states.
Findings list updates and supports navigation.

scenarios.title: TM triage list and apply flow
steps: Open a BE translation file with EN source available.
Switch to TM panel and run suggestion lookup.
Apply one suggestion and verify translation updates.
Confirm grouping/filter controls still respond.
expected_checks: TM panel renders suggestions without UI freeze.
Applied suggestion updates current row value.
TM controls remain interactive after apply.

scenarios.title: Source-reference mode and fallback behavior
steps: Open BE file and focus source column header controls.
Change source-reference mode and fallback settings.
Navigate several rows and inspect source content updates.
Re-open preferences and confirm persistence.
expected_checks: Source-reference selector responds without errors.
Fallback mode changes update source text deterministically.
Preferences values round-trip across reopen.

scenarios.title: Optional TZP status-comment writeback
steps: Open BE/ui.txt and edit value and status for one key.
Save file with TZP writeback opt-in enabled in scenario extras.
Inspect saved file comments and confirm namespaced TZP marker behavior.
expected_checks: Writeback is opt-in and active only for this scenario.
Only namespaced TZP comments are added/updated/removed.
Non-namespaced user comments are not mutated.

scenarios.title: Status triage mixed-selection status-bar indicator
steps: Open BE/ui.txt and select multiple rows with different status values.
Use toolbar status actions to keep at least two selected rows in different statuses.
Observe status bar while mixed selection stays active.
Switch selection to a single row and then to uniform multi-row selection.
expected_checks: Status bar shows Selection: mixed (N rows) only for mixed multi-row selection.
Indicator is not shown for single-row selection.
Indicator is not shown for uniform multi-row status selection.

scenarios.title: Search+replace sidebar flow with all-scope confirmation
steps: Open BE/ui.txt and switch to Search panel.
Use sidebar controls to set query, replacement, regex, case, and search field.
Run Replace All in FILE scope, then LOCALE/POOL scopes via Preferences, and confirm modal summary each time.
Cancel one confirmation and verify no replacement is applied for that run.
expected_checks: Sidebar and toolbar controls stay synchronized in both directions.
Replace All confirmation modal appears for FILE, LOCALE, and POOL when matches exist.
Modal summary includes scope label, total replacements, and affected files.
Cancel prevents apply and leaves values unchanged for the canceled run.
